resources.string: On your server, run rafiq-bridge pair --name followed by a name for this phone. Enter the server address and the code it prints.
That code is wrong, expired or already used. Run rafiq-bridge pair again for a new one.
Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
Your server removed this phone. Pair it again to carry on.
This phone is unpaired, but your server could not be reached, so it still lists this device. Remove it there with rafiq-bridge revoke %1$s.
This phone is unpaired, but your server could not be reached, so it still lists this device. Run rafiq-bridge devices, then rafiq-bridge revoke with its id.
